construction._L: 88.9 mm (the gear's measured half face width) + 215.9 mm (8.5 in bar standoff past the rim) + the pivot's own offset along the bar: 50 mm on asset 6 (top), 30 mm on asset 7 (bottom). These two were SWAPPED until 2026-08-20 -- measured on the machine, the top pivot stands 20 mm further out than the bottom, and the config had it the other way. The standoffs are what nothing checks: get both wrong by the same amount and the whole rotor slides along its axis silently.
